court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Civil Judge, Senior Division Jalgaon - M.P.No.140/2019
case_name: Smt. Tejaswini Bhushan Ahire vs Shri. Bhushan Vasantrao Ahire
facts_of_case: Wife filed an application under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 for transfer of divorce petition filed by husband to another court.

legal_principles.principle: In the interest of justice, a court may transfer a petition to another court.
legal_principles.held: Hence, in the interest of justice, this Hon'ble Court be pleased to transfer the marriage petition from Jalgaon to Malshiras, Dist. Solapur.

legal_principles.principle: A court may permit service by hand delivery with the help of a bailiff.
legal_principles.held: He submits that the Applicant may be permitted to serve the Respondent by hand delivery in the Jalgaon court with the help of Bailiff, if necessary.

outcome.final_order: Notice issued to respondent for final disposal, returnable on 26.07.2019; liberty granted to serve respondent by hand delivery in the trial court with the help of Bailiff, if necessary.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for transfer of divorce proceedings
advising on jurisdictional issues in family law cases
preparing an application under section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure
